api_key_id.description: ApiKey record id this webhook is presented with. Auth is by key, so several webhooks may share one key.

api_key_name.description: ApiKey friendly name, denormalized for display

enabled.description: Whether this webhook accepts inbound requests

error_count.description: Total processing errors on this webhook

event_type.description: Optional pinned lifecycle status for this webhook. Leave blank for dynamic: the status is then read from lead_status on the payload. Accepts Sold, Unsold, Returned, Rejected, Duplicate, Disqualified, Converted.

last_error.description: Summary of the most recent processing error

last_received_at.description: Timestamp of the last successful receipt on this webhook

name.description: Display name for this inbound webhook, e.g. Inbounds Webhook or Legenex Webhook

notes.description: Free text note, e.g. which platform posts to this webhook

purpose.description: What this webhook carries. Absent or 'lead_outcome' is the pre-existing behaviour: a buyer or platform posting a lifecycle status. 'buyer_feedback' writes a BuyerFeedback record, 'inbound_call' records a call outcome, 'cost' records spend.

match_field.description: Our field used to find the lead this payload belongs to: sid, buyer_id, email, mobile, lead_id or utm_source. Absent means the built-in resolution order, which is what every existing route uses.

match_key.description: Payload key holding the match value, when the sender does not use one of the known aliases

date_key.description: Payload key holding the event date for this receipt

field_map.description: JSON object mapping payload key -> our field name, applied before the built-in alias resolution. Lets a sender post its own column names without a code change.

provider.description: DEPRECATED. Legacy source-system tag from the per-route token model. Retained for history only, no longer written or displayed.

receipt_count.description: Total successful receipts on this webhook

supplier_name.description: Optional supplier attribution when the payload carries no sid. The sid on the payload always wins.

token_hash.description: DEPRECATED. SHA-256 of the old per-route token. Retained so legacy leadbyteWebhook routes keep working during cutover.

token_hint.description: DEPRECATED. Last 4 characters of the old per-route token, display only.
